newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit rangebound ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit rangebound ahead of weekend.

text.p: * Ringgit rangebound on lack of fresh leads and ahead of
* Talk of dollar selling orders at 2.6400
* Market awaits release of June trade data
The ringgit was rangebound against the dollar in early Asian trading as activity died down ahead of the weekend and on lack of fresh leads, dealers said.
"There's nothing much happening this morning but I'm still looking at a weaker ringgit," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
He said the underlying tone of the dollar against regional currencies remains bullish.
But talk of large orders to sell the dollar at 2.6400 was likely to limit its rise, dealers said.
Dealers said market focus is now on Malaysia's June trade data which is expected to be released early next week.
The market was abuzz with talk of a 1.5 billion ringgit deficit in June, they said.
Malaysia had a trade surplus of 157 million ringgit in May.
At 0215 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.6370/90 to a dollar.
